name: Administrator Login
description: Restricts login and password reset to administrator accounts (via the login form).
project_description:
Administrator Login

 Features 
 The Administrator Login module is designed exclusively for users with the administrator role. If your Drupal site is intended solely for administrators, enabling this module will ensure that only those with the administrator role can log in and reset passwords. This provides an additional layer of security by preventing non-administrative users from accessing the site. By activating this module, you can effectively safeguard your site's login process and restrict access to authorised personnel only, thereby enhancing the overall security and integrity of your Drupal installation.

 Post-Installation 
 Install and enable the module, then log out of the current user session. Attempt to log in again—only users with the administrator role will be permitted to access the site; others will be denied.
